author: Eric Hensel
text: Fasi and her team were just a pleasure and joy. Teff everything, flour nothing and perfectly flavored food and coffee / teff milk drinks. Unique desert / cake as well. I have been all over the south eating Ethiopian food and her place is unique and possibly vying for a personal favorite....time will tell if I can maintain that claim.

author: Motuma Shume
text: As someone working in hospitality, I really appreciated the atmosphere at Love Grass Restaurant. The restaurant has a calm, relaxing ambiance and it feels elegant and gives the impression of an Ethiopian fine dining restaurant. I also liked the clean, simple design, and the staff were humble, polite, and welcoming. The attention to detail creates a pleasant dining experience. If the restaurant had a larger space, I believe it could make an even bigger impact and set a higher standard for Ethiopian fine dining and hospitality in Dubai. Wishing the team continued success—I look forward to visiting again.

author: Henny B D
text: The imported injera, paired with freshly baked tikus injera, beautifully complemented the flavors of our lunch. The jebena coffee was truly the icing on the cake. We ordered the fasting plate (no meat or dairy), and every bite was absolutely delicious. It was a pleasure dining at your establishment. Thank you for the warm welcome. Our server, Alex, and the coffee lady, Aregu, made our visit exceptional with their attentive service and friendly demeanor.

author: Getahun Abebe
text: Best ethiopian foods. The atmosphere is very decent. They service all kinds of ethiopian traditional food.

author: Pinkdot
text: When you enter the restaurant, it has this authentic look making it both minimalistic and traditional. The food was executed beautifully and was easily identifiable as organic and natural. The service could not be any better. I have personally felt their hospitality, hard work and dedication by being offered a beautiful salad as the appetizer and at the end treated with a spectacular presentation of coffee and dessert without any question. This place is truly very amazing and 100% deserving of 5 stars. I would DEFINITELY recommend this restaurant to anyone. -Maedot Melaku

author: Sharon Gezahegn
text: This place is a 10/10!!!! I just don’t have words how excited I am to find this type of place in Dubai. all the staff’s are like a family if feels like home the food is a top tier you will never find any place that has this original taste in Dubai 🤤 I’m so obsessed

author: Azeb Assefa
text: I have a great experience that gives me home feeling and reminds me of my mother hand. The “Qategha”that I eat in love grass is the best experience after a long time of waiting. I highly recommend this lovely Ethiopia authentic restaurant to feel home and get amazing service.
